desc: 淡紫灰石膏棚景，超薄芯体层解与加宽腰围贴合实拍
leaf: 婴儿超薄柔棉腰贴式纸尿裤
name: 超薄柔棉婴儿纸尿裤款

shots.intent: 用淡紫灰骨白基调与产品正视形态定住全set尺度，抓搜索第一眼点击。
用婴儿扭动的背影场景放大夜间闷湿不适，全程不触碰医疗表述。
shots.textZone: top center headline in #3A3438 at 32pt reading 「{headline_1}」, one lake-blue #4E8FA8 open circle with an inset dot beneath it

shots.intent: 左右并置的芯体剖解把不适痛点翻译成结构机制，降低对功效话术的依赖。
shots.textZone: two-column headers in #3A3438 at 20pt, small labels at 14pt reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把产品放进夜色安睡场景，用成人在旁托抱的安定感回应上一屏痛点。
shots.textZone: lower left label in #3A3438 at 16pt reading 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 特写腰贴与弹力腰围贴合结构，证明穿戴稳固不勒，是本品最可辩护的形态证据。
shots.textZone: lower right label in #3A3438 at 14pt reading 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 微距展示立体防漏隔边与表层凹凸纹理，把做工细节变成可感知的柔软。
shots.textZone: upper left label in #3A3438 at 14pt reading 「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 把产品带入白天活动场景，用婴儿背影与成人陪玩展示穿戴灵活。
shots.textZone: left center headline in #3A3438 at 32pt reading 「{headline_2}」

shots.intent: 以被划除的对立图标讲清不做哪些添加，用否定式表达代替任何安全认证背书。
shots.textZone: headline in #F4F1EC at 32pt reading 「{headline_3}」, three strike-through circle labels in #F4F1EC at 14pt reading 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 「{callout_7}」

shots.intent: 用同一形态多件并排暗示可选规格，数量与型号一律留白交由文案层填写。
shots.textZone: lower center variant labels in #3A3438 at 16pt reading 「{variant_1}」 「{variant_2}」 「{variant_3}」

shots.intent: 回到首图同一棚景与同一色板收束整组，留出干净写有号召语的收口位。
shots.textZone: bottom center call to action in #F4F1EC at 20pt on a lake-blue #4E8FA8 band reading 「{cta_text}」

style.backgroundSystem: pale grey plaster wall #F4F1EC as the only depth plane, with one suspended circular fabric drape ring in #C6BCCB behind the product; no other scenery, no horizon clutter
style.iconSystem: one thin lake-blue #4E8FA8 open circle with a single inset dot, reused as the only icon mark in the set
style.lightingSystem: single soft diffused 5300K key from the upper left, generous wrap fill from camera right, soft grounded contact shadow under the product, calm matte mood, no hard specular hotspot except on genuine film surfaces
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: soft desaturated infant-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of bone-white #F4F1EC, lilac-grey #C6BCCB, deep ink-grey #3A3438 and one lake-blue accent #4E8FA8; neutral temperature; single soft diffused 5300K key from the upper left with gentle wrap fill and soft grounded contact shadows; background of pale grey plaster wall with one suspended circular fabric drape ring; matte plaster plus brushed non-woven surface language; one modern geometric sans-serif family; a single thin lake-blue #4E8FA8 open circle with one inset dot as the only icon mark; stable centered product scale on a fixed horizon line with real contact shadows; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no QR codes and no numeric claims.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no hex outside 淡紫灰 #C6BCCB / 骨白 #F4F1EC / 深墨灰 #3A3438 / 湖蓝 #4E8FA8
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering

no absorbency volume, no dryness hours, no breathability percentage
no material composition wording, no imported or premium material claim
no rash, itch, redness or any treatment or prevention medical wording
